Among these breakthroughs, Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as particularly transformative, with systems like Ope- nAI’s GPT-4 [1], Anthropic’s Claude, Google’s Gemini, and Meta’s Llama [2] demonstrating re- markable capabilities in understanding, generating, and reasoning with human language. These models have enabled widely-adopted applications such as ChatGPT, which reached 100 million users within two months of its launch, representing one of the fastest technology adoptions in history [3]. Contemporary LLMs now demonstrate sophisticated reasoning abilities, code genera- tion capabilities, and multimodal understanding that extends beyond text to images and structured data. Trained on vast corpora of text data, they have evolved from simple statistical approaches to sophisticated neural architectures capable of complex tasks including text generation, translation, summarization,andknowledgeextraction[4].
